privacyPage.p1: We collect account identifiers, order history, delivery addresses, device/app diagnostics, and payment status only as needed to operate Night Cabinet (mystery-box commerce), prevent fraud, and fulfill shipments.
privacyPage.p2: You can export your data or delete your account in Settings → privacy controls. Deletion anonymizes your profile, disables login, and clears push tokens; some order records may be retained for legal, tax, and dispute resolution.
privacyPage.p3: We do not sell personal data. Analytics and crash tools (when enabled) process technical logs under our processors’ terms. Contact support for privacy requests.
privacyPage.p4: Payments are processed by licensed payment partners (e.g. VNPay / WeChat / App Store). We receive payment results, not full card numbers.
privacyPage.p5: Continued use means you agree to the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy. Users under 18 must not purchase random-draw products.
